record.oneLiner: Squarespace provides Commerce APIs (Orders, Inventory, Products, Forms, Contacts, Discounts) authenticated via Bearer tokens (merchant API keys or OAuth 2.0) requiring a Commerce Advanced plan.
record.verdictReason: Squarespace has a documented REST API covering e-commerce and store management objects. Credentials can be generated self-serve by merchants on the Commerce Advanced plan, and third-party community MCP servers exist.

evidence.quote: Squarespace Commerce APIs accept two credential types over one wire format. Every request carries Authorization: Bearer <token>, where the token is either a merchant-generated API key or an OAuth 2.0 access token.
With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site. Follow the steps below to generate an API key for a custom application.

API permission levels
Forms API
Read Only : View form submission data; for Zapier integration only
Inventory API
Read Only : View inventory stock levels
Read and Write : Manage inventory stock levels
Orders API
